entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order, press 1. For technical support, press 2. For all other inquiries, please stay on the line.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for an order I placed about a month ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-112025. It was for a pair of spin class shoes.

Got it, thank you. I'm pulling that up now... I see the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes, delivered 34 days ago. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoe or more of a preference matter?
It's more about the fit. I've used them a few times, and no matter how I position the cleats or adjust the straps, they're giving me blisters on my heel. They just aren't comfortable for me.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Since it's a fit issue and not a defect, let me just check our return policy for you.

Alright, looking at the policy here... our standard return window is 90 days from the delivery date. Since you're at day 34, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and approve a full refund for you.

That’s good to hear. I appreciate you approving the refund. Now, since I did have to go through the trouble of testing them and now have to package them up and send them back, would it be possible to get a 10% discount code for my next purchase? I still plan on buying another model from you.

I understand the request, and I'm glad you're planning to stick with VeloFit for your next pair. However, our system is set up to provide a full refund for the returned item, but we aren't able to add a separate discount code on top of that for a standard return.
I see. Not even a small credit for the inconvenience? The full refund is the main thing, of course, but a little something for the effort would be nice.

I really do understand, but company policy strictly limits credits to situations involving a business fault, which doesn't apply here. The best I can offer is to process this return for the full purchase price. I've just initiated that for you and you'll be receiving a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 15 minutes.
Okay, fair enough. A full refund is what I called for, so I'll take it. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
